If there are issues, I'm prepared to authorize a replacement in this same huddle, provided it satisfies all requirements from your reports.

transcript.text: I need to flag a compliance exception on the proposed Delta Financial investment. I reviewed the applicable collateral-investment mandate this week and found that the cash collateral may only be placed in government Treasury bills or AAA-rated bank certificates of deposit, each with a maturity of no more than 14 days. The proposed 30-day commercial paper from Delta Financial violates this restriction on two counts — it's not an permitted instrument type and the maturity exceeds the 14-day limit. This restriction has not yet been added to the desk's pre-trade checklist, which is why it hasn't been flagged in our system-generated reports.
